name: aws_emr_cluster
description: Creates an Amazon EMR cluster for big data processing using open-source frameworks such as Apache Spark, Hive, Presto, and Hadoop.

name.name: name
name.description: The name of the EMR cluster.

release_label.name: release_label
release_label.description: The release label for the Amazon EMR release. E.g., emr-6.6.0.

service_role.name: service_role
service_role.description: IAM role that will be assumed by the Amazon EMR service to access AWS resources.

applications.name: applications
applications.description: A list of applications to install on the cluster. E.g., Spark, Hive, Presto.

log_uri.name: log_uri
log_uri.description: S3 bucket to write the log files to.

termination_protection.name: termination_protection
termination_protection.description: Switch on/off termination protection (default is false, except when using multiple master nodes).

keep_job_flow_alive_when_no_steps.name: keep_job_flow_alive_when_no_steps
keep_job_flow_alive_when_no_steps.description: Switch on/off run cluster with no steps or when all steps are complete.

scale_down_behavior.name: scale_down_behavior
scale_down_behavior.description: The way that individual Amazon EC2 instances terminate when an automatic scale-in activity occurs.

autoscaling_role.name: autoscaling_role
autoscaling_role.description: IAM role for automatic scaling policies.

visible_to_all_users.name: visible_to_all_users
visible_to_all_users.description: Whether the job flow is visible to all IAM users.
